event_chain.summary: Pretexting as Judiciary official via spoofed email
Bank details changed, fraudulent wires sent

summary: An unknown attacker using a lookalike email address impersonated a Judiciary of Guam official and, with forged verification documents, persuaded the Guam Department of Administration's Accounts Payable section to change the banking details for a pending payment to the Judiciary. About $1.68 million was wired on February 16 and about $107,000 on February 18 to a fraudulent Wells Fargo account; about $1 million was moved to JPMorgan Chase accounts and seized by the FBI on May 4. The fraud was discovered February 23; roughly $800,000 remained missing. The Judiciary never received the intended funds.
